create_resize_shortest_edge_transformer: create a ResizeShortestEdge transformer to resize observation images to a target shortest edge size
create_center_cropper_transformer: create a CenterCropper transformer to center crop observation images to a fixed height and width
create_cubemap_to_equirect_transformer: create a CubeMap2Equirect transformer to stitch six cubemap sensors into a single equirectangular image
create_cubemap_to_fisheye_transformer: create a CubeMap2Fisheye transformer to stitch six cubemap sensors into a fisheye image
apply_obs_transforms_batch: apply a list of observation transformers to a batch of tensor observations sequentially
